**Refusal: Physically impossible kinematics**

The request cannot be fulfilled because W = 1.05 GeV is below the pion production threshold for all charged and neutral pion channels:

| Channel | Threshold W |
|---|---|
| γ + p → p + π⁺ | ≈ 1.088 GeV |
| γ + p → p + π⁰ | ≈ 1.073 GeV |
| γ + n → n + π⁰ | ≈ 1.075 GeV |

Since 1.05 GeV < 1.073 GeV, no pion channel can be produced at this energy. The EXCLURAD code requires W above threshold to compute radiative corrections for pion electroproduction.
